ISerializeChunk is a read-only pair: text carries a string, bytes carries Uint8Array, and value carries an already-completed unknown business value. Text and bytes have wire representations; value has no implicit text or byte form. ISerializeChunkKind is the union of those three labels.

ISerializeParser requires name, encode(value, context) and decode(chunk, context), with optional dispose(). Encode can return a chunk, a Promise of one chunk, a synchronous Iterable or an AsyncIterable. Decode returns a value or Promise. ISerializeOutput names that four-way encoding-output union. A synchronous parser can return directly without creating its own Promise. ISerializeContext contains the composed signal and diagnostic context string. The field is context rather than the old source name, keeping it distinct from error ownership. ISerializePlugin pairs type with parser.

registry.encode collects one parser output into one chunk. All-text chunks join as text. Once bytes appear, text is encoded and the output is assembled as bytes. A value chunk must be the only output: combining it with anything produces INVALID_CHUNK. Zero chunks produce ENCODE_FAILED. Incremental admission records actual chunkIndex and bytesConsumed and checks cancellation before consumption. Failed async iteration invokes iterator.return; secondary cleanup failures go to report without replacing the primary failure.

isChunkShape distinguishes a single chunk from a chunk container: it requires an array of length two whose first item is a string. It does not validate the label. Later validation distinguishes unknown labels, non-string text data and non-Uint8Array bytes. Boundary tuple fields are captured facts rather than values to reinterpret through repeated later reads.

Root constants and value unions use canonical domains: SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind are text/bytes/value; SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat are text/structured/binary; SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat are json/yaml/toml; SerializePhase/ISerializePhase are encode/decode; SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy are throw/report; SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind are cleanup-error/drain-timeout; SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType are json. These labels neither emit instrumentation events nor introduce error codes.

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) requires a nonempty plugin array. The first type becomes primaryType. Each type is an ASCII token of 1–64 characters, starting with a letter/digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN is /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i. assertSerializeType rejects invalid tokens with RangeError/INVALID_OPTION. HTML and archive-envelope writers still need correct escaping; token validation is not output escaping.

Types must be unique. Each parser needs callable encode/decode, and dispose must be callable when supplied. Empty lists and duplicate types produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION; malformed structures produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. Plugin lists, fields and methods are admitted before ownership transfers. Later input mutation cannot replace captured behavior. Failed admission invokes neither parser work nor parser cleanup and creates no partially owned parser set to roll back. Options default to an empty object and must be an object or function when supplied.

rows: systemScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler, fixed at creation. Requires callable now/schedule and finite now results.
Host TextEncoder. An injected capability must implement encode(string): Uint8Array; omission with no host implementation produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED.
Host TextDecoder. Injection requires decode(Uint8Array): string; omission without host support produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED. Captured and validated here, not automatically passed to JSON parsers.
{ policy: 'throw' }, or { policy: 'report', report } with a callable reporter.
No-op observer when a deadline is already past, or expires with work pending; pendingCount can be zero.
No-op observer for failures arriving after public settlement and secondary iterator cleanup failures.

blocks.text: Option getters, scheduler operations and Encoding capability boundaries retain original causes rather than leaking unclassified property-access failures. scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) returns a task with cancel() and optional unref(). Core timer use does not read global timer functions.

primaryType is the first format. types lists registered types in order; has(type) checks membership. encode(value, options?) and decode(chunk, options?) return Promises. Operation type defaults to primaryType, context to anonymous and signal to omission. The parser receives a composition of caller and internal closing signals: the first observed cancellation wins. Unknown formats produce CODEC_NOT_FOUND with context fixed to registry. ISerializeRegistry names the returned interface and ISerializeRegistryOptions the construction options.

Decode first checks closing, then finds the requested format, then validates the chunk. The corresponding failure priority is REGISTRY_DISPOSED, CODEC_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHUNK. Closed-registry failures are tagged native Errors rather than necessarily SerializeCodecError instances. Even if a parser ignores signal, the framework rejects on cancellation and discards late output; that does not forcibly terminate synchronous computation or an external task.

close() is synchronous and idempotent: it denies new operations and aborts current ones without disposing parsers. dispose(options?) closes first, drains, then awaits each parser disposer. Sharing one parser under several types still disposes that instance once. Repeated dispose calls return the first Promise by identity.

The sole disposal option deadlineAt defaults to undefined. A supplied value must be a finite absolute time in the scheduler.now clock domain. The first admitted call fixes it; later calls cannot replace it. The deadline bounds draining, not parser cleanup. If the deadline is already past or expires while waiting, onDrainTimeout can receive { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount } before cleanup continues. pendingCount can be zero. A drain timeout is a diagnostic event rather than a new error code. ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic describes it; ISerializeCleanupError describes cleanup-failure events.

Signal state is rechecked immediately after listener registration without depending on host event replay. An already-closing internal signal takes precedence at entry. Cancellation causes retain identity, and failing signal reads produce INVALID_OPTION. Public Promises can reject promptly while registry still tracks the underlying parser task; close itself does not wait.

With cleanup.policy throw, cleanup failure rejects disposal. If another primary failure already exists, secondary failures stay in errors, using AggregateError when necessary to retain all originals. Report policy emits { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } while allowing normal settlement. Diagnostic callback failures cannot rewrite an already-published result; report failures reach the shared utils host-error path. Detached task failures remain observed without rejoining a closed lifecycle. Omitting report retains the existing no-op policy.

jsonParser(options?) returns a parser named json; jsonPlugin(options?) returns a plugin of type json. IJsonPluginOptions replacer, reviver and space default to omission and feed JSON.stringify, JSON.parse and indentation respectively. The optional byte decoder falls back to the host TextDecoder. Options default to an empty object. Native JSON semantics are distinct from strict portable codec validation.

Encode returns text and rejects when stringify returns undefined. Native encoding failures receive ENCODE_FAILED. Decode returns value payloads unchanged, parses text directly and decodes bytes before parsing. Missing decoding capability produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED; parse failures receive DECODE_FAILED. A standalone parser also provides error identity. Annotatable native errors retain instance, type and stack; conflicting or non-extensible errors are retained as the cause of a coded TypeError wrapper.

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) and chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) require their Encoding argument. The former returns text unchanged or decodes bytes. The latter encodes text or returns a slice copy of bytes, without sharing the original array. Both reject value chunks with TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK. Conversion failures are tagged at the decode/encode boundary with their causes retained.

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) is an async generator over a read-only array. Options and scheduler are required; core provides no default global timer. On resumption after yield, it observes the consumer’s slice-processing time, estimates a next size using targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05), averages that estimate with the current size and clamps to minItems/maxItems. This is cooperative slicing rather than a frame-rate guarantee on every device. IFrameBudgetOptions names slicing options, IEncodeStreamOptions adds encoding settings, and ICollectStreamOptions names collection policy. A custom yieldTo owns its Promise and cancellation behavior; its wait is not guaranteed to abort promptly.

rows: 64; safe integer of at least one.
250000; safe integer no smaller than minItems.
2048; safe integer of at least one, clamped to the configured bounds.
scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0) when omitted; the default wait responds to signal cancellation.
Omitted; checked before proceeding to the next slice.
Required: finite now results and scheduled tasks with cancel().

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) adds type (registry default format), context (stream) and maxInFlight (1, a positive safe integer) to those options. It calls registry.encode independently for each slice and yields in input order. maxInFlight bounds concurrent encoding requests. Adjacent JSON array slices are not one complete JSON document: decode frames separately and combine arrays in the application when that is the intended result.

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) accepts a synchronous or asynchronous chunk iterable. Options default to an empty object, type to the registry format, context to stream and signal to omission. It decodes and yields each frame without assembling the complete result. Stream encoding/decoding failures wrap ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED with the outer frame index, bytesConsumed zero and the inner error on cause. That position differs from the parser’s internal chunk index.

Stream entry points capture options before acquiring an iterator, so admission failures are not mislabeled as iteration failures. Cancellation is rechecked across async boundaries. Early source/generator completion closes its owned iterator; secondary return failures are reported without replacing the primary failure. An early encodeStream break cancels operations it created and observes outstanding tasks without waiting forever for uncooperative parser code. Registry disposal still owns parser draining.

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) is for consumers that actually need one complete result; it retains the whole output. Signal defaults to omission, empty defaults to text (returning ['text', ''] for an empty stream), the other empty policy is reject, and context defaults to stream. All-text data joins as text. A single byte chunk can return directly; multiple chunks with any bytes require an explicit encoder, even when all are bytes. Without it, ENV_UNSUPPORTED is raised; core does not read a global TextEncoder. Value chunks always produce INVALID_CHUNK. Malformed tuples retain chunkIndex and accumulated bytesConsumed, source iteration failures become ENCODE_FAILED, and abort preserves cancellation identity with iterator cleanup handled at its boundary.

bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) returns complete RFC 4648 Base64. base64ToBytes(string) requires canonical padding and valid unused trailing bits. Invalid input produces TypeError/INVALID_OPTION whose cause retains the original utils INVALID_ENCODING failure. This differs from unpadded base64url used by portable tags.

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) is a lazy synchronous Generator, yielding pieces without assembling one full string. Empty input yields none. Its internal block length is 32763 bytes, divisible by three so padding cannot corrupt an intermediate boundary; block size is not an option. Algorithms come from utils/bytes without constructing a whole binary string or using btoa/atob. Use bytesToBase64 when the destination requires one string, and keep bytes as bytes when the destination supports them. The 4/3 size expansion is a format property, not a performance measurement.

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` has read-only id, version, encodedType, encode and decode. Encode/decode are function properties preserving strict parameter variance. TId defaults to string and TVersion to number. encodedType is unknown/string/uint8array. A synchronous codec is a different contract from an asynchronous registry parser. identityCodec fixes id=identity, version=1 and encodedType=unknown; both functions preserve the exact value and concrete type. The old alias and unversioned identity entry are removed.

defineJsonCodec, defineMessagePackCodec and defineCBORCodec require a positive safe-integer options.version and return frozen codecs. IDs are json, message-pack and cbor; outputs are string, Uint8Array and Uint8Array respectively. All three use the same portable projection/validation. JSON sorts keys deterministically; MessagePack sorts keys without extensions. CBOR disables records and host extensions, converting decoded bigint integers to numbers only when they are exact safe integers; otherwise it rejects.

defineProtobufCodec requires version, schema and binding. schema.id matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u and schema.version is a positive safe integer independent of codec.version. Binding must be a generated Buf DescMessage rather than custom encode/decode hooks. The returned schema identity is frozen, values use `MessageShape<TBinding>`, and encodedType is uint8array. Encode/decode validate genuine Uint8Array data and preserve original Buf failure causes. Factories provide no storage or network envelope.

ICodecValue’s static domain contains null, boolean, number, string, nested read-only arrays and records; finite numbers still require runtime checks. normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) preserves errors already owned by serialize and wraps other failures in TypeError with cause. CodecErrorText owns stable version, schema, encoding, decoding and portable-rejection diagnostics.

sections.heading: Portable defaults and the reusable walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) is the legacy intermediate projection rather than a final assertion. It reads sorted string keys and recursively produces mutable ordinary objects without freezing. Uint8Array becomes { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }. Inherited, nonenumerable and symbol record fields are omitted. Getters may run. Repeated sibling references are copied independently, while cycles are checked on the active ancestor path. Projection can temporarily retain undefined/NaN; codecs reject them during final portable validation.

assertPortableValue(value, active?) returns void. asCodecValue(value) validates and returns the same object narrowed to ICodecValue. Neither copies nor freezes. The default decoded profile rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, functions, symbols, bigint, Date/Map/Set, invalid arrays and native bytes. Recognized byte tags retain the existing character-set checks rather than a different protocol’s stricter canonical-bit policy. Default depth is unlimited. Legacy projections of ArrayBuffer/class objects are not general-purpose safe snapshots.

Import createPortableWalker from root or codec, create it once per module/owner and reuse it. walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) returns { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }; walk.value uses the same recursion but returns only the value. Active is the caller’s ancestor Set, otherwise created as needed for the call, with no retained graph afterward. Initial depth defaults to zero; the root is depth zero and only depth greater than maxDepth fails. The optional native-binary guard belongs to that invocation rather than global registration.

rows: Required. Returns a primitive or { value, violation? }, preserving deferred-failure precedence.
Required. Returns inline base64url text, borrowed Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer, or undefined for container admission.
Required for native results; reads intrinsic lengths rather than caller-shadowed properties.
Required. Returns { entries, output?, tag?, hasBinary?, validate? } or undefined. Entries may be captured or lazy; omitting output validates in place.
Optional. Returns the array or { value, length?, violation? }; defaults to map, with captured length avoiding another read.
arrayValue(value, ownedVisit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds, context)
Mutually exclusive with array. Returns the raw projection through the provided traversal’s lexical ownership, without implementing another recursion.
Unlimited by default; the strategy chooses its budget.

Optional. Default defineProperty keeps own `__proto__` data from changing the output prototype.
Optional container finalization such as freezing; native leaves are neither copied nor frozen and do not call finish.
Required. Throws a caller-owned coded native error retaining the original cause and stack.

blocks.text: Context supplies reject, isAncestor, isUint8Array, bytesToBase64url, isCanonicalBase64url and optional beforeNativeBinary. Generic reasons include depth/cycle/access/ancestor; strategies own other reasons. Context is for synchronous hook use. Classified errors retain identity; application callback failures go through violation('access', original), and caller ancestor-Set failures retain their existing boundary.

byteUpperBound is a conservative JSON UTF-8 bound rather than an exact length: up to six escape bytes per UTF-16 unit, up to 32 per number, plus container punctuation and byte tags. Value, bound and hasBinary are fused in one traversal without rescanning the input. Strategies supply native lengths; this value is not a complete shared-backing/offset protocol budget.

IPortableBinaryResult is the unboxed union string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer. Borrowed native objects retain exact identity without copying/freezing. The second finish argument proves only native descendants; hasBinary also includes inline tags and grants no protocol permission. Reentrant getters restore outer accounting and active paths. Completed calls retain no caller graph, and the value-only array path does not add output-length observations.

Default JSON/MessagePack/CBOR remain inline-only with existing wire bytes and failure precedence: projection finishes before deferred validation fails, so a later getter failure can still take precedence. RPC’s null prototypes, freezing, parent-field capture, depth 64, canonical tags and protocol identities belong to rpc-contract strategies. Serialize embeds no consumer profile, manifest or native-negotiation owner.

emitOutput(value, format?) synchronously returns complete text. Format defaults to json, with yaml/toml alternatives. JSON reuses jsonParser. YAML/TOML are output-only without third-party runtimes, and are not registry parsers.

Inputs contain finite numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and plain own-data records. JSON/YAML accept null. Descriptor admission rejects enumerable accessors without evaluating them, along with cycles, sparse arrays, named array properties, enumerable symbols, unsupported values and nonplain prototypes. No toJSON, replacer or business getter is invoked. Failure returns no partial string and diagnostics do not echo input.

TOML requires a record root and rejects null at every depth as well as unpaired surrogates. Keys/strings are quoted and nested collections retain their shapes. Negative zero becomes -0.0; unsafe integers use floating-point spelling instead of the TOML integer domain. Failures are tagged native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with read failures retained as causes. These strict own-data rules differ from legacy portable projection.

SerializeCodecError(message, details) requires code, type, phase, chunkIndex and bytesConsumed, with optional context, source and cause. Source defaults to @migaia/serialize and TCode to ISerializeErrorCode; consumers can reuse the class with their own code union/source. Phase is encode/decode and cause retains the original object. Codec failures and native construction/lifecycle failures use different carriers, so branch on (source, code) rather than instanceof alone.

rows: REGISTRY_DISPOSED: new work after close/dispose, tagged Error.
CODEC_NOT_FOUND: unregistered format, SerializeCodecError with context=registry.
ENCODE_FAILED: encoding, empty output or stream iteration failure, retaining cause.
DECODE_FAILED: parsing or frame decoding fails.
INVALID_CHUNK: invalid tuple/label/data, mixed value output or value-to-wire conversion.
ABORTED: cooperative cancellation; SerializeCodecError or tagged native error depending on the boundary.
INVALID_OPTION: invalid plugin, version, portable input, scheduler, stream option, Base64 or output admission.
ENV_UNSUPPORTED: required host capabilities such as Encoding are unavailable.

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) returns the original error with read-only source/code. Omitted context stays absent. Repeating the same identity is idempotent, with context filled only once. Identity conflicts delegate to utils and throw (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT), retaining the original error on cause instead of silently overwriting ownership.

ISerializeTaggedError adds source/code/context to a native error type. ISerializeTypeError and ISerializeRangeError retain their native types; ISerializeLifecycleError also permits errors. createSerializeError, createSerializeTypeError and createSerializeRangeError create coded native Error/TypeError/RangeError. Code/message are required. Options default to omission and permit cause/context; the ordinary Error also permits a frozen errors snapshot. Codes are public API, and error factories never rewrite stack. Empty output reports zero progress. Malformed decode chunks report zero progress, while parser decode failures report that chunk’s byte count. Stream wrappers use outer frame positions without losing inner causes.

For value-to-wire or mixed-value failures, return to the business value rather than forcing a representation. For CODEC_NOT_FOUND inspect types and the saved type tag. REGISTRY_DISPOSED requires a new registry. Multi-chunk byte collection requires an explicit encoder. If exports still block, inspect initial slice size, bounds and yieldTo; slicing is not preemptive termination.

A complete workflow creates the registry, encodes independent frames into the real sink, decodes them individually at the receiver, reads old formats using saved type tags and writes the default primaryType. Apply UTF-8/Base64 only at an actual text boundary, then await dispose. A configured deadline limits draining only. module scripts provide fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and a separate build; unverified historical measurements are not performance claims.

guidance.heading: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式

blocks.text: 配置下载需要 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，分别拼接文本时，对输入值的接受规则不同，同一份设置可能得到不一致的内容。
手写格式化会把值校验、引号转义和嵌套集合语法混在一起，增加格式时容易顺带改变保留哪些字段或怎样转义字符串。
把配置交给 `emitOutput()`，用 `SerializeTextFormat` 选择格式。三种格式共用普通数据接纳规则，每次调用都会先对输入校验并投影，再输出所选格式；省略格式时使用 JSON。
emitOutput 的第一个参数是普通自有数据，第二个 format 可省略，默认 json；SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml 分别选择另外两种输出。theme 和 retries 是业务字段。格式全集为 json/yaml/toml，YAML/TOML 只生成文本，不提供反向 parser。

import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: 输出：
依次输出 `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`、`YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`，然后三行 `TOML:`、`"theme" = "dark"`、`"retries" = 2`。
三种输出保留了传入字段，YAML 使用合法的流式集合语法。这是文本生成工具，不是 YAML 或 TOML 解析器。TOML 要求根值为记录并拒绝 null，其余格式也会拒绝不支持的值，不会悄悄省略。

guidance.id: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式
guidance.heading: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式

blocks.text: 配置下载需要 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，分别拼接文本时，对输入值的接受规则不同，同一份设置可能得到不一致的内容。
手写格式化会把值校验、引号转义和嵌套集合语法混在一起，增加格式时容易顺带改变保留哪些字段或怎样转义字符串。
把配置交给 `emitOutput()`，用 `SerializeTextFormat` 选择格式。三种格式共用普通数据接纳规则，每次调用都会先对输入校验并投影，再输出所选格式；省略格式时使用 JSON。
emitOutput 的第一个参数是普通自有数据，第二个 format 可省略，默认 json；SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml 分别选择另外两种输出。theme 和 retries 是业务字段。格式全集为 json/yaml/toml，YAML/TOML 只生成文本，不提供反向 parser。

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: 输出：
依次输出 `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`、`YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`，然后三行 `TOML:`、`"theme" = "dark"`、`"retries" = 2`。
三种输出保留了传入字段，YAML 使用合法的流式集合语法。这是文本生成工具，不是 YAML 或 TOML 解析器。TOML 要求根值为记录并拒绝 null，其余格式也会拒绝不支持的值，不会悄悄省略。

symbols.name: createPortableWalker
symbols.signature: export declare function createPortableWalker(strategy: IPortableWalkerStrategy): IPortableWalker;
symbols.purpose: Creates a synchronous specialized walker with policy callbacks captured once. The returned callable projects a value and byte metadata; its value method avoids metadata collection. Policy callbacks own validation and coded errors, and traversal owns cycle tracking.
symbols.core:
strategy: Caller-owned IPortableWalkerStrategy with scalar, binary, record and violation hooks. Optional array, field-write and finish hooks specialize projection; callbacks are synchronous and throwing stops traversal.
A callable walker(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) returning { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }, plus walker.value with the same arguments returning only the projection. Input is caller-owned, active is an optional enclosing ancestor Set, initialDepth defaults to zero, and beforeNativeBinary is an optional no-argument throwing guard exposed to policy context rather than automatically called. byteUpperBound is conservative JSON/native-byte accounting, not an encoded measurement; hasBinary records inline or native binary presence. Failures use strategy.violation.
parameters: strategy: IPortableWalkerStrategy
symbols.returns: IPortableWalker

symbols.name: ICodec
symbols.signature: export type ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId extends string = string, TVersion extends number = number> = Readonly<{ /** Stable format identity, separate from parser registry plugin routing. */ id: TId; /** Explicit format revision; built-in factories require a positive safe integer. */ version: TVersion; /** Unknown preserves arbitrary values, string carries text, and uint8array carries binary frames. */ encodedType: 'unknown' | 'string' | 'uint8array'; /** * Synchronously converts a domain value to the declared representation; format failures are * thrown. */ encode: (value: TValue) => TEncoded; /** * Synchronously restores the codec's domain value; decoding does not imply original object * identity. */ decode: (value: TEncoded) => TValue; }>;
symbols.purpose: Generic synchronous codec object containing format identity, explicit version, encoded representation and two callbacks. Format factories freeze the codec object; they do not freeze decoded application data.
symbols.core:
id: Codec format identifier fixed by its factory, such as `json`, `cbor`, `message-pack`, `protobuf` or `identity`.
version: The version number supplied when creating this codec, which converts values to a data format and back. It identifies the format version that producers and consumers agree to use. The codec retains the number; changing the original construction options later does not change this property.
encodedType: Declares the runtime representation produced by encoding so a transport can admit the correct payload shape.
Identity representation preserves any input without changing object identity.
Text representation emitted by the JSON format codec.
Byte representation emitted by CBOR, MessagePack and Protobuf codecs.
encode: Synchronously converts the supplied application value to the codec representation; built-in format failures carry package codes and original causes.
encode.value: Application value admitted by this codec; portable formats accept `ICodecValue`, while Protobuf accepts its generated message shape.
The encoded `TEncoded` value; identity returns the input itself, while format codecs return text or bytes.
decode: Synchronously restores the application value from this codec representation; invalid portable data or malformed format data throws.
decode.value: Encoded value returned by the matching codec encode operation, or received from a carrier using that format and version.
The decoded `TValue`; identity returns the same object, portable formats validate the result and Protobuf returns its message shape.
symbols.advanced: A transport selects admission and wire behavior from codec metadata while keeping application types generic.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

symbols.core:
maxDepth: Maximum admitted traversal depth, where root depth defaults to zero. Finite limits must be nonnegative safe integers.
Infinity, so no strategy depth ceiling is imposed.
scalar: Synchronous hook receiving primitive candidate value and walker context. Return a primitive or { value, violation? }; a deferred violation is raised after projection, while context.reject fails immediately.
scalar.value: Primitive node supplied by traversal from the caller input graph.
scalar.context: Invocation tools: reject(reason, cause?), isAncestor(object), isUint8Array, bytesToBase64url and isCanonicalBase64url; these are synchronous and reject throws.
Projected scalar or deferred scalar result; a throw aborts the traversal.
record: Synchronous hook receiving an object and context. Return undefined for array handling, or entries with optional output. A tag emits an inline bytes object instead of traversing entries; hasBinary marks an existing binary tag, and validate checks the completed record. Entry children are traversed by the walker; missing output validates without constructing a record.
record.value: Current object node supplied by traversal.
record.context: Current invocation rejection, ancestor and binary helper tools.
Record admission or undefined. Optional validate(output) synchronously returns a violation reason or undefined; any throw aborts traversal through policy handling.
binary: Synchronous hook receiving an object and context before record or array handling. Return inline text or native storage for an atomic binary node, or undefined for ordinary traversal.
binary.value: Object candidate supplied by traversal before container admission.
binary.context: Current rejection, ancestor, byte detection and canonical base64url helper tools.
IPortableBinaryResult or undefined. Without nativeByteLength only inline strings are supported; a throw stops traversal.
nativeByteLength: Synchronous hook receiving admitted Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer and returning its byte length through the owner intrinsic accessor. Required only for strategies returning native binary storage.
nativeByteLength.value: Native binary storage returned by the same strategy binary callback.
Native byte count used in byteUpperBound; a throw becomes a traversal policy failure.
Absent; the binary hook is then restricted to inline strings or undefined.
array: Synchronous array hook receives value, visit(child) and context. Visit each child with the supplied callback; return the projected array or { value, length?, violation? }. It cannot be supplied with arrayValue.
array.value: Input array node supplied by traversal.
array.visit: Synchronous child visitor owned by the walker; returns one projected child and propagates traversal failures.
array.context: Current invocation rejection and binary helper tools.
Projected array or array admission; thrown errors stop traversal.
Uses value.map(visit), retaining native map, species and hole behavior.
arrayValue: Alternative synchronous raw array hook receiving value, owned visit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds and context. Invoke visit(child, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds) for children; cannot coexist with array.
arrayValue.value: Input array node from traversal.
arrayValue.visit: Owned synchronous visitor accepting child, depth, ancestors, guard and bounds and returning a projected child.
arrayValue.childDepth: Walker-computed depth for immediate array children.
arrayValue.ancestors: Invocation-owned active ancestor set; pass it to the supplied visitor.
arrayValue.guard: Optional caller-supplied native-binary rejection guard; defaults to absent.
arrayValue.bounds: Whether this invocation collects byte metadata rather than value only.
arrayValue.context: Invocation-owned rejection and binary helper tools.
The projected array value without an admission wrapper; errors propagate through policy handling.
Absent; ordinary array handling is used instead.
key: Synchronous hook receiving each record key and context before writing its child. Return nothing; reject or throw to forbid a field name.
key.key: Record key yielded by the strategy entries iterable.
key.context: Current invocation tools whose reject method throws a policy violation.
No result is used; normal return admits the key.
No key policy; all keys supplied by record entries are admitted.
write: Synchronous hook receiving output record, admitted key and projected child. Write the field using strategy-owned prototype and property semantics; a throw stops traversal.
write.output: Output record returned by the strategy record callback.
write.key: Admitted entry key from the record entries iterable.
write.child: Child value already projected by the walker.
No result is used; the output record is updated in place.

finish: Synchronous hook applied after each array, record or inline bytes-tag projection; primitive and native-binary nodes bypass it. Receives that node and its native-binary descendant flag; return the published node, or throw to stop.

Final caller-selected projection; identity finish retains the projected value.
Identity callback returns the projected value unchanged.
violation: Required synchronous failure hook receiving reason and optional original cause. Must throw the caller-owned coded native error; no recovery value is accepted.
violation.reason: Walker-owned classification such as depth, cycle, access, scalar, prototype, binary, tag or sparse.

Its portable profile admits null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, dense arrays and ordinary records; encoding validates and projects supported data before stringify, while decoding parses and validates without freezing the result. Unsupported scalars such as NaN reject rather than silently becoming null. This differs from the native-JSON registry plugin, and the version is not embedded in the encoded text.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a frozen synchronous JSON codec with explicit version metadata. Its portable profile admits null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, dense arrays and ordinary records; encoding validates and projects supported data before stringify, while decoding parses and validates without freezing the result. Unsupported scalars such as NaN reject rather than silently becoming null. This differs from the native-JSON registry plugin, and the version is not embedded in the encoded text.

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

symbols.purpose: Adaptively slices an application array, encodes each slice through a registry and yields ordered chunks with bounded in-flight encoding. Pair it with a registry created by `createSerializeRegistry` and an installed parser such as `jsonPlugin`; the example consumes each chunk directly with `chunkToText`. A receiver can instead use `decodeStream` to restore separate arrays. Concatenating JSON slice texts does not make one JSON document. The runnable case imports `@migaia/utils/scheduler` directly: install `@migaia/utils` as a direct dependency alongside this package.
symbols.core:
registry: ISerializeRegistry created by createSerializeRegistry with the desired parser plugins installed.
items: Caller-owned array to divide into slices; each slice is encoded as an independent array value.
AsyncGenerator<ISerializeChunk> in original slice order. Breaking iteration cancels owned work; parser failures retain slice position and cause, while option admission uses INVALID_OPTION.
targetMs: Positive finite consumer processing budget in milliseconds; measured elapsed time adjusts the next slice size.
`8` milliseconds per slice; this is a target rather than a hard execution deadline.
minItems: Positive safe integer lower bound on items per slice, reducing overhead from very small batches.
`64` items, including the lower clamp applied to the initial slice.
maxItems: Positive safe integer upper bound on items per slice; must be at least `minItems`.
`250000` items; adaptive growth never exceeds this upper bound.
initialItems: Positive safe integer initial size before consumer timing is available; clamped between the item bounds.
`2048` items before clamping to `minItems` and `maxItems`.
yieldTo: Optional no-argument async callback invoked between slices. Resolve after yielding execution; a throw or rejection stops iteration.
A `Promise<void>` whose fulfillment permits the next slice; rejection reaches the stream consumer.
Schedules a zero-delay task with the supplied scheduler; its wait observes cancellation.
signal: Caller-owned structural `IAbortSignal`, usually from `createAbortController().signal`, requests cooperative cancellation.
`undefined`: no caller cancellation signal is installed.
scheduler: Required `IScheduler`, with no default: `now()` returns finite monotonic milliseconds; `schedule(callback, delayMs)` asynchronously schedules the no-argument callback and returns a task with idempotent `cancel()` and optional `unref()`. An optional `defer(callback)` is part of the scheduler contract but is not required for slicing. Use `systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler` for host scheduling.
type: Registered format tag selected from registry.types or a stored envelope.
The registry primaryType from its first registered plugin.
context: Caller diagnostic label identifying the logical stream in errors.
The literal `stream` label is used when omitted.
maxInFlight: Positive safe integer limit on concurrent slice encoding promises; higher values overlap work while retaining more slices.
`1`, waiting for one encoded slice before admitting the next.

options: IEncodeStreamOptions

sections.content: Adaptively slices an application array, encodes each slice through a registry and yields ordered chunks with bounded in-flight encoding. Pair it with a registry created by `createSerializeRegistry` and an installed parser such as `jsonPlugin`; the example consumes each chunk directly with `chunkToText`. A receiver can instead use `decodeStream` to restore separate arrays. Concatenating JSON slice texts does not make one JSON document. The runnable case imports `@migaia/utils/scheduler` directly: install `@migaia/utils` as a direct dependency alongside this package.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
registry: ISerializeRegistry created by createSerializeRegistry with the desired parser plugins installed.
items: Caller-owned array to divide into slices; each slice is encoded as an independent array value.
AsyncGenerator<ISerializeChunk> in original slice order. Breaking iteration cancels owned work; parser failures retain slice position and cause, while option admission uses INVALID_OPTION.
targetMs: Positive finite consumer processing budget in milliseconds; measured elapsed time adjusts the next slice size.
`8` milliseconds per slice; this is a target rather than a hard execution deadline.
minItems: Positive safe integer lower bound on items per slice, reducing overhead from very small batches.
`64` items, including the lower clamp applied to the initial slice.
maxItems: Positive safe integer upper bound on items per slice; must be at least `minItems`.
`250000` items; adaptive growth never exceeds this upper bound.
initialItems: Positive safe integer initial size before consumer timing is available; clamped between the item bounds.
`2048` items before clamping to `minItems` and `maxItems`.
yieldTo: Optional no-argument async callback invoked between slices. Resolve after yielding execution; a throw or rejection stops iteration.
A `Promise<void>` whose fulfillment permits the next slice; rejection reaches the stream consumer.
Schedules a zero-delay task with the supplied scheduler; its wait observes cancellation.
signal: Caller-owned structural `IAbortSignal`, usually from `createAbortController().signal`, requests cooperative cancellation.
`undefined`: no caller cancellation signal is installed.
scheduler: Required `IScheduler`, with no default: `now()` returns finite monotonic milliseconds; `schedule(callback, delayMs)` asynchronously schedules the no-argument callback and returns a task with idempotent `cancel()` and optional `unref()`. An optional `defer(callback)` is part of the scheduler contract but is not required for slicing. Use `systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler` for host scheduling.
type: Registered format tag selected from registry.types or a stored envelope.
The registry primaryType from its first registered plugin.
context: Caller diagnostic label identifying the logical stream in errors.
The literal `stream` label is used when omitted.
maxInFlight: Positive safe integer limit on concurrent slice encoding promises; higher values overlap work while retaining more slices.
`1`, waiting for one encoded slice before admitting the next.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum slice size, default 250000; must be a positive safe integer at least minItems.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial size, default 2048; a positive safe integer clamped to the configured min/max bounds.

declaredConfiguration.name: yieldTo
declaredConfiguration.description: Yield mechanism. Defaults to `scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)`. Can use `scheduler.yield()` for finer scheduling or requestIdleCallback for a more conservative yield. A custom callback owns its own cancellation and settlement; it cannot forcibly interrupt consumer work.

declaredConfiguration.description: Required runtime-neutral scheduler. Core has no default timer and never directly accesses host `setTimeout`, `performance`, or `Date.now`.

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

Idempotent and * never invokes parser disposers. */ close(): void; /** * Closes first, then drains pending work until settlement or `deadlineAt` before awaiting parser * cleanup. Invalid deadline input rejects before closing, * and cleanup failures follow the configured throw/report policy. */ dispose(options?: { /** * Finite absolute scheduler-clock deadline; omitted waits indefinitely, past values skip * draining. */ readonly deadlineAt?: number; }): Promise<void>; };
symbols.purpose: Registry instance returned by createSerializeRegistry, owning parser admission, asynchronous operation tracking and two-phase shutdown. Close cancels admission; dispose drains then releases resources with stable promise identity.
symbols.core:
primaryType: Default write and read type captured from the first plugin passed to `createSerializeRegistry`.
types: Snapshot of registered type strings in plugin order; no registration API adds formats after construction.
has: Checks whether a format is currently registered; returns false after disposal clears the parser table.
has.type: Format tag copied from a stored envelope or chosen from this registry types list.
`true` for a registered format, `false` otherwise; it does not start any parser work.
encode: Runs one parser and assembles its chunks into one complete result. Caller cancellation or close rejects promptly even if parser work ignores its signal.
encode.value: Application value supplied by the caller and admitted by the selected parser.
encode.options: Optional operation fields: `type` defaults to the first plugin; `signal` defaults to no caller signal; `context` defaults to `anonymous`. Obtain type from plugin registration or an envelope and signal from an abort controller.
A `Promise<ISerializeChunk>`: one value, concatenated text, or merged bytes. Rejects with `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`, `CODEC_NOT_FOUND`, `ABORTED`, `ENCODE_FAILED` or `INVALID_CHUNK`; parser failure remains on cause.
decode: Validates one chunk then runs its selected parser, preserving the original payload identity where the parser permits.
decode.chunk: Chunk returned by encode or reconstructed from a stored envelope; select its original format through options.type.
decode.options: Optional `type`, `signal` and `context`; defaults are the first plugin, no caller signal, and `anonymous`. Read type from the stored envelope, and signal from an abort controller.
A promise of the parser result. Rejects on closure, unknown format, cancellation, malformed chunks or parser failure with `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`, `CODEC_NOT_FOUND`, `ABORTED`, `INVALID_CHUNK` or `DECODE_FAILED`.
close: Synchronously stops admission and aborts the registry closing signal. Repeated calls are harmless; parser disposers are not invoked here.
Admission is closed and running public operations observe cancellation; use dispose to wait for resource cleanup.
dispose: Closes admission, drains pending parser work, then awaits owned parser disposers. Repeated calls return the same promise; the first admitted call fixes its deadline.
dispose.options: Optional `deadlineAt`: finite absolute time in the construction scheduler clock. Default is no deadline; obtain it from scheduler.now() plus a duration. Expired deadlines skip draining but still clean parsers.
Shared `Promise<void>` settling after parser cleanup. A deadline emits a diagnostic rather than a timeout rejection; cleanup follows the configured throw or report policy.

replacer: Synchronous native JSON.stringify callback: key is the current property name, including empty root key; value is its current value. Return replacement or undefined to omit an object property; thrown errors reach the parser caller.
replacer.key: Property name supplied by native JSON serialization, or the empty root key.
replacer.value: Current value supplied by native JSON after its ordinary conversion steps.
Replacement value consumed synchronously by JSON.stringify; promises are ordinary values and are not awaited.
No replacer; native JSON serialization decides omission and conversion.
reviver: Synchronous native JSON.parse callback: key is the parsed property name and value is the parsed child. Return a replacement or undefined to remove it; thrown errors reach the parser caller. Value chunks bypass this callback.
reviver.key: Property name supplied during native JSON parse traversal, including the empty root key.
reviver.value: Parsed child value supplied by native JSON before replacement.
Replacement value consumed synchronously; async restoration is unsupported.
No reviver; parsed JSON values keep their native shapes.
space: Native JSON indentation width. Numeric values are clamped by JSON.stringify to the range zero through ten.
No indentation; native JSON.stringify emits compact text.
decoder: Structural byte-to-text decoder used only for byte chunks before JSON.parse. Its throw reaches the direct parser caller or is wrapped by a registry.
Creates a host TextDecoder when byte decoding is needed; absence then throws ENV_UNSUPPORTED.

symbols.name: createSerializeRegistry
symbols.signature: export declare function createSerializeRegistry(plugins: readonly ISerializePlugin[], options?: ISerializeRegistryOptions): ISerializeRegistry;
symbols.purpose: Creates a registry owning a nonempty plugin set and parser cleanup. The first plugin selects default writes and reads; types and methods are captured at construction and duplicate types reject. Chunks carry only kind and payload, so older formats must be selected using their separately stored `type`. The migration case uses JSON parser options `replacer` and `reviver`: both receive the current property key (including an empty root key) and value, synchronously return its replacement, and default to `undefined`. The old reader maps numeric theme 0 to light through its reviver; `space` defaults to undefined (compact output), and `decoder` defaults to a host TextDecoder when bytes are decoded. Returning undefined from the replacer omits an object property. These plugin options are separate from registry options below.
symbols.core:
plugins: Required nonempty ordered `ISerializePlugin` array. Every descriptor requires unique `type` matching `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i` and `parser`. A parser requires diagnostic `name`, callable `encode(value, context)` and `decode(chunk, context)`; optional zero-argument `dispose()` defaults to absent. Context has required `signal` and string `context`. Encoding returns a chunk, Promise of one, or sync/async iterable of chunks; decoding returns a value or Promise. Chunk kinds are `["text", string]`, `["bytes", Uint8Array]` and `["value", unknown]`. There are no defaults for required fields. Shared parser objects are disposed once. The first type selects default writes and reads; persist the type separately when formats coexist.
ISerializeRegistry with close and promise-idempotent dispose. Invalid lists or capabilities throw INVALID_OPTION; missing host encoding capabilities throw ENV_UNSUPPORTED. Construction validates before taking parser ownership.
scheduler: Fixed `IScheduler` for disposal deadlines; provide it from `@migaia/utils/scheduler` or a compatible monotonic clock implementation.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
encoder: Fixed `ITextEncoder` used to merge mixed text and byte parser output; its encode method retains the original receiver.
A host `TextEncoder`; construction throws `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` when unavailable.
decoder: Fixed `ITextDecoder` capability captured and validated at construction; JSON plugin byte decoding has its own decoder option.
A host `TextDecoder`; construction throws `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` when unavailable.
cleanup: Controls parser-disposer failure handling: throw retains cleanup failures in disposal rejection; report sends one diagnostic and preserves the primary outcome.
`{ policy: "throw" }`, so unhandled parser cleanup failures reject disposal.
cleanup.policy: Chooses the cleanup error boundary; report requires cleanup.report and never changes an existing primary failure.
cleanup.report: Synchronous callback used only by report policy. Receives `d: ISerializeCleanupError` once after cleanup failure, returns nothing; thrown reporter failures are contained.
cleanup.report.d: Cleanup diagnostic created by the registry with package source and original cleanup error.
No return value is used; throwing does not change the disposal result.
onDrainTimeout: Synchronous observer receiving `d: ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic` when draining reaches its deadline. Returns nothing; thrown observer failures are contained.
onDrainTimeout.d: Registry-created diagnostic with deadline and current pending count.
No return value is used; parser cleanup proceeds even if the observer throws.
A fixed no-op observer; deadline behavior remains unchanged.
report: Callback receiving secondary iterator-cleanup and detached late failures immediately, including after cancellation but before disposal completes; detached `ABORTED` remains observable. No return value changes the operation.
report.error: Original failure observed by the registry after a primary result or cleanup boundary.
No return value is used and the primary operation outcome is unchanged.
A fixed no-op reporter; supply a callback when late failure visibility is required.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to `systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Fixed at construction; the scheduler subpath defines its monotonic clock contract.

declaredConfiguration.name: encoder
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to the host `TextEncoder`, explicitly requiring the Encoding API. Fixed at construction and used when encoded text must join byte output.

declaredConfiguration.name: decoder
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to the host `TextDecoder`, explicitly requiring the Encoding API. Fixed at construction. Parser-specific decoding remains owned by the parser; this option does not replace a JSON plugin's own decoder configuration.

declaredConfiguration.name: cleanup
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Reject disposal with cleanup failure, retaining an earlier primary. */ readonly policy: typeof SerializeCleanupPolicy.throw; } | { /** Observe cleanup failure without making it the disposal primary. */ readonly policy: typeof SerializeCleanupPolicy.report; /** Required for report policy; receives the original cleanup diagnostic. */ readonly report: (d: ISerializeCleanupError) => void; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional cleanup error policy. Defaults to `{ policy: 'throw' }`. The report policy requires a reporter.

declaredConfiguration.name: cleanup.policy
declaredConfiguration.description: Observe cleanup failure without making it the disposal primary.

declaredConfiguration.name: cleanup.report
declaredConfiguration.description: Required for report policy; receives the original cleanup diagnostic.

declaredConfiguration.name: onDrainTimeout
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional drain-timeout observer, default no-op; synchronous observer failure does not prevent cleanup.

declaredConfiguration.name: report
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional reporter for secondary or late registry failures. Defaults to a fixed static no-op. Reports iterator `return()` failures during active draining through `drainAsyncIterable`. Also reports late rejections from detached work after the deadline and cleanup through `track`. Late work does not rejoin the registry lifecycle. Neither report changes the primary rejection or terminal state.
